title: FY2026 Services Flywheel Initiation
thesis_statement: Apple's services segment is entering a durable high-margin growth phase driven by install-base monetisation, which the market is systematically undervaluing. A 20x services EV/EBITDA would yield a $230 PT.

observations.content: Apple services revenue grew 14% YoY in Q1 FY2026 to $26.3B, beating consensus of $25.9B.

inferences.content: Services growth acceleration from 12% to 14% YoY suggests the install-base monetisation flywheel is strengthening, not plateauing.

decisions.rationale: Services segment undervalued at current blended multiple. 12-month PT assumes services re-rates to 20x EV/EBITDA.

assumptions.label: Services Revenue 3-Year CAGR
assumptions.rationale: Extrapolating recent acceleration; install base growing 8% pa and ARPU expanding 5% pa implying ~13% blended growth.

predictions.description: Apple services revenue exceeds $110B in FY2026
predictions.resolution_rule: Resolved using Apple FY2026 annual report; metric = total Services segment revenue as reported.
